title: Calm clinical visual direction
summary: A clean, precise clinical monochrome softened by sparse warm secondary tones — calm, airy, and trustworthy rather than sterile or dashboard-like.
defaults: Hue: clinical monochrome base softened by at most two warm secondary tones (soft yellow, beige, brown, or moss green) used sparingly
Surface: bright white-adjacent monochrome surface (#FAFAF7 range), never pure white
Density: spacious scanning rhythm — generous gaps, unhurried hierarchy, clear breathing room
Let the warm secondaries signpost sections and supporting states; the primary action stays monochrome-backed
risks: Secondary tones multiplying into three or more competing hues
Sterility where the direction calls for warm, calm trust
verification: At most two warm secondary tones accompany the monochrome base
Body text reaches 4.5:1 contrast on the clinical surface
No pure #000000/#FFFFFF values and no three-plus saturated hues appear

example_startups.name: Neko Health
example_startups.note: Warm optimistic secondaries (yellow, beige, brown, green) softening clinical monochrome into trust and calm

visual_rules: Use exactly one signature accent color, sparingly, for identity and primary CTAs
Derive all neutral tones from one base hue at varying opacities; never use pure #000000 or #FFFFFF
Keep body text contrast at least 4.5:1 and button or CTA contrast at least 3:1 against adjacent colors
Never combine three or more saturated hues in one view
